data.body: **[P1] Avoid occupying the worker needed by queued operations while draining.** With `withExecutorService(Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor())`, a handler that starts `ctx.stepAsync(...)` and returns now hangs indefinitely: the root task holds the only worker while `drainOperations()` waits for the queued step. Previously, draining occurred in the caller's `close()` after the root task released that worker. Arrange draining without consuming the executor capacity needed by queued operations, while preserving lifecycle-hook ordering. Add a single-thread, unawaited-step regression test; the added two-thread test misses this case.
